title: Thrilling Wildlife Encounters at Yala National Park
description: Get up close with leopards, elephants, and exotic birds in Sri Lanka's most famous wildlife sanctuary.
author: Tourvir Team
introduction: Yala National Park combines dry woodland and coastal landscapes on Sri Lanka's southeastern side.

sections.heading: Wildlife Encounters in Yala
paragraphs: Yala is known for wildlife including leopards, elephants, sloth bears, crocodiles, and many bird species.
Sightings are never guaranteed, so the landscape and the wider safari experience are important parts of a visit.

sections.heading: Plan a Wildlife Route
paragraphs: A safari is easier to plan when it is considered alongside travel time, accommodation, and the other stops in your itinerary.
